issue_deck: Patty Primetimes leaves a game-flipping haul on the pine while Joe Mantegna hands out a 54-point clinic.

lead_story.headline: The 25-Point Omission That Handed Ginger FC 🏆🏆 a Victory
body: Fantasy football management is often celebrated as a delicate art, but Week 6 proved it is frequently a terrifying exercise in leaving your winnings in the trousers you threw in the hamper. Patty Primetimes learned this lesson the agonizing way, dropping a 3.78-point squeaker to Ginger FC 🏆🏆 despite having 25.20 points of optimized scoring rotting on the bench. Had Keon Coleman and Isaiah Likely been inserted for Courtland Sutton and Josh Downs, Patty Primetimes would not only have survived but coasted to a comfortable 21.42-point triumph.

Instead, Ginger FC 🏆🏆 collected a remarkably fortunate win while ranking 7th in weekly scoring with 104.18 points, proving once again that in this league, showing up with an unoptimized roster is an invitation to get mugged by the schedule. Patty Primetimes walks away from Week 6 at an even 3-3, left to wonder why real points are so frequently traded for hypothetical ones.

matchup_recaps.headline: A 3.78-Point Escape Act
matchup_recaps.body: Ginger FC 🏆🏆 entered this historical series down 1-8-0 against Patty Primetimes and promptly benefited from a masterclass in bench-stashing. While Ginger FC 🏆🏆 posted a clean 100.0% lineup efficiency with zero points left on the pine, Patty Primetimes left 25.20 points idle. The 104.18 to 100.40 final margin kept Ginger FC 🏆🏆 smiling despite a modest 7th-best weekly score.

matchup_recaps.headline: ThreatLevelMidnight Handed a Bad Beat
matchup_recaps.body: Pop Lockett Drop it continued an impressive run at the top of the standings by holding off ThreatLevelMidnight 125.84 to 110.62. ThreatLevelMidnight authored one of the week's quintessential bad beats, ranking 5th in weekly scoring with 110.62 points and an expected win rate of 0.6364, only to run into a buzzsaw while Pop Lockett Drop it secured a tidy 96.11% lineup efficiency.

matchup_recaps.headline: Gronkowski Sets the Week's High-Water Mark
matchup_recaps.body: The Big Gronkowski laid down the hammer in Week 6, pacing the entire league with a massive 133.70 points in a 21.82-point victory over Uncle Rico. Uncle Rico managed 111.88 points and a robust 8-3 all-play record on the week, which unfortunately only earned them the distinction of suffering the week's other premier bad beat against the league's highest-scoring machine.

matchup_recaps.headline: Efficiency Prevails Over Puuump's Bench
matchup_recaps.body: Malle ❤️ 🐸 carved out a 106.66 to 78.32 victory over Buttermilk Puuump, backed by a sharp 91.43% lineup efficiency. Buttermilk Puuump left 19.50 points on the bench—including Mark Andrews and Terry McLaurin—while sliding deeper into the basement at 0-6-0.

matchup_recaps.headline: A Lucky Win Masked by Lineup Clunkers
matchup_recaps.body: Voldemort snapped a two-game losing streak and pushed career wins to 75.0 by defeating malle_dips_pouches 86.66 to 45.80. Despite ranking 9th in weekly scoring and posting the week's worst lineup efficiency at 76.83% with 26.14 bench points, Voldemort claimed a wildly lucky win as malle_dips_pouches turned in the lowest score of the week.

matchup_recaps.headline: The Most Lethal Blowout of the Slate
matchup_recaps.body: Joe Mantegna dismantled Post Mahomes 116.24 to 61.78 in the most lopsided affair of Week 6. Operating with a pristine 100.0% lineup efficiency and zero points left on the bench, Joe Mantegna improved to 4-2-0 while dropping Post Mahomes to a matching 3-3-0 record.

managerial_desk.headline: The Anatomy of Left-Behind Loot
managerial_desk.body: Voldemort earned the dubious honor of worst managerial decision of the week, leaving 26.14 points on the bench through a 76.83% efficient lineup that featured Brock Purdy and Juwan Johnson starting over Jayden Daniels and Kyle Pitts Sr. Close behind, Patty Primetimes committed two avoidable start errors by trusting Courtland Sutton and Josh Downs over Keon Coleman and Isaiah Likely, single-handedly converting a potential 21.42-point blowout win into a 3.78-point defeat. Meanwhile, Ginger FC 🏆🏆, Joe Mantegna, and ThreatLevelMidnight shared the gold standard of executive competence by posting flawless 100.0% lineup efficiencies with zero points wasted.

luck_report.headline: Where Expected Wins Go to Die
luck_report.body: Uncle Rico and ThreatLevelMidnight found themselves trapped in the Week 6 Chamber of Horrors. Uncle Rico posted 111.88 points—good for the 4th-highest score of the week—and a stellar 0.7273 expected win rate, yet walked away with a loss against The Big Gronkowski. ThreatLevelMidnight suffered a similar fate with 110.62 points and an 0.6364 expected win rate against Pop Lockett Drop it. Conversely, Voldemort and Ginger FC 🏆🏆 enjoyed charmed afternoons, capturing official victories despite ranking 9th and 7th in scoring with expected win rates of 0.2727 and 0.4545 respectively.

record_book.headline: Brushing Against the Infinite Floor
record_book.body: malle_dips_pouches flirted with league infamy during their 45.80-point implosion against Voldemort, coming within just 1.9 points of the all-time lowest single-game score record of 43.9 points. On the bright side of history, Voldemort quietly cleared a major career milestone, locking down victory number 75.0 all-time.

previews.headline: History Chases Gronkowski
previews.body: Voldemort holds a historical edge in this series with a 10-6-0 record across 16 prior meetings against The Big Gronkowski. However, projections paint a tighter picture for Week 7, favoring The Big Gronkowski at 95.16 points to Voldemort's 88.74.

previews.headline: Familiar Territory for Malle
previews.body: Malle ❤️ 🐸 carries an 8-4-0 historical advantage into the week against Patty Primetimes across 12 past matchups. The projection model likes that trajectory, tabbing Malle ❤️ 🐸 at 85.97 points over Patty Primetimes at 71.58.

previews.headline: A Razor-Thin Historical Rivalry Meets a Model Gap
previews.body: Joe Mantegna holds a narrow 6-5-0 historical edge over Pop Lockett Drop it across 11 games. Despite that historical dead-heat, projections heavily favor Pop Lockett Drop it at 121.49 points compared to Joe Mantegna's 72.94.

previews.headline: ThreatLevelMidnight Looks to Extend Past Dominance
previews.body: ThreatLevelMidnight holds a 7-3-0 historical lead over Uncle Rico through 10 previous meetings. Week 7 projections back that historical advantage up, slating ThreatLevelMidnight at 110.46 points against Uncle Rico's 86.62.

previews.headline: Post Mahomes Defends Historical Turf
previews.body: Post Mahomes holds a 9-4-0 historical edge against Ginger FC 🏆🏆 across 13 prior encounters. The projection model narrowly favors Post Mahomes at 84.54 points to Ginger FC 🏆🏆 at 74.98.

previews.headline: An Even Slate and a Heavy Projection Spread
previews.body: The historical series between malle_dips_pouches and Buttermilk Puuump sits dead even at 2-2-0 across four meetings. Projections suggest a more definitive outcome for Week 7, tabbing malle_dips_pouches at 123.94 points over Buttermilk Puuump at 70.71.

closing_shot: If Patty Primetimes spent half as much energy setting a starting lineup as they do inventing new ways to waste 25 points on the bench, they might actually threaten the top of the standings.
